test_title: PYST 18: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 14th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Advance
solution:
The correct answer is **Retreat.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Advance: **to move forward.
 
• **Retreat: ** to move backward in order to leave a battle or in order not to become involved
